properties.note: pre-reaction ion-dipole complex (one dot-joined complex): HO- on the face opposite the epoxide O, d(O(H-)-C1)=3.81 A; lowest of three converged conformers (rc_c1/c2/c4_opt_freq.log, all -385.4446202); soft modes -23/-9 cm-1

anti/backside (Walden inversion) TS, SMD water model: verified stationary point, exactly 1 imaginary frequency -419.37 cm-1, Normal termination. Loose saddle with d(C1-Od)=2.67 A that retains an Od-H...O(epoxide) contact and lies ~70 kcal/mol above the contact basin, i.e. on the ion-pair approach / continuum-cavity-merging coordinate; identified structurally, not IRC-verified
trans-2-hydroxycyclohexan-1-olate, NImag=0, geometry-verified diequatorial (H-C1-C2-H dihedral -171 deg)

syn/frontside (retention) TS, SMD water model: verified stationary point, exactly 1 imaginary frequency -491.70 cm-1, Normal termination. Loose saddle, d(C1-Od)=2.39 A, ~47 kcal/mol above the contact basin; its lower energy relative to the anti TS is a continuum-model artefact (see REPORT.md section 3), not evidence that cis-1,2 is the major product
cis-2-hydroxycyclohexan-1-olate, NImag=0, geometry-verified H-C1-C2-H dihedral +36 deg
